live_claim_statement: For n up to 10, the learned mechanism's revenue matches the Straight-Jacket auction benchmark exactly.
paper_table_scope: One buyer with independent Uniform([0,1]^n) values and n in {1,2,5,10,20}; compare mean profit per item to SJa where available.
paper_actual_wording: For all available cases, the revenue achieved by our mechanisms is virtually identical to that of SJa.
exact_falsification_contract: At least one n<=10 row in the source-bound table has unequal learned and benchmark decimals at the reported precision.
rounding_policy: Parse the displayed three-decimal strings as exact decimals; do not introduce a tolerance for the word exactly.
verdict_scope: The literal live exact-match claim, not the paper's softer virtually-identical claim.
